fee_notes: Standard new franchisee fee is $69,900. E-2 Investor Visa franchisees pay $69,900-$90,000 plus a Reserve. Conversion program for existing property management companies may reduce fee to $0-$69,900 based on gross monthly revenue.
raw_excerpt: The Franchise Fee for a franchisee starting a new Business is $69,900. For non-U.S. residents who have or are obtaining E-2 Investor Visas...the Franchise Fee is between $69,900 - $90,000...The Initial Franchise Fee may range from $0 to $69,900.
